name: Tiny Platformer
tagline: A yellow square, a brick cave, and a best run that is still there when you come back.
description:
Run, jump, take the gold, bounce on the grey blocks. Hit one from the side and you start over; gold you already took stays taken. When the eight gold bricks and the eight grey ones are gone, the cave is cleared.

On a phone the buttons sit under your thumbs — left, right, jump. On a computer it is the arrows or WASD, and space or up to jump. Close it, come back: your best gold count is still there.

An unofficial port of Tiny Platformer by Jake Gordon, MIT-licensed. This copy adds the phone buttons, follows you with the camera, and keeps your best run.
